description: This file defines an abstract class VarianceBase within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, specifically for statistical variance calculations. It contains protected static methods for datatype adjustments on input values.

classes.name: VarianceBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing helper methods for variance calculations in statistical computations within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: datatypeAdjustmentAllowStrings
methods.description: Adjusts data type, converting booleans to integers, strings to zero, and returning other types unchanged.

methods.name: datatypeAdjustmentBooleans
methods.description: Adjusts boolean data types to integers if in OpenOffice compatibility mode; otherwise returns the value unchanged.
